artifact_title: VC-45 Standard-RLM counting Results and Program Traces
artifact_description: One VC-45 task subgroup, pre-output locked after the disclosed outcome-blind no-call parser grammar repair, evaluated with standard rlms v0.1.3; every input context, raw response, generated program trajectory, token count, latency, and captured cost is retained.
contract: Pre-output-locked Oolong validation-split subgroup, after one outcome-blind no-call parser grammar repair, evaluated with standard rlms v0.1.3 on standard/unlabeled context_window_text, Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenRouter, and complete trajectory capture.
